marketSummary: Indian equities are navigating sharp headline volatility after the RBI Monetary Policy Committee delivered a surprise 25 bps repo rate hike to 5.50% and shifted its stance to 'calibrated tightening' on crude and currency pressures, pulling the Nifty 50 below 22,600. While rate-sensitive financials and auto names face near-term multiple compression, strong stock-specific momentum is unfolding in retail and consumer discretionary following stellar Q2 operational updates, alongside sustained positioning in capital goods, power T&D, and defence manufacturing names.
dailyFocus: Prioritize high-relative-strength base breakouts insulated from interest-rate headwinds—specifically Trent's high-volume thrust out of a multi-month consolidation, alongside capital goods and defence leaders (HAL, BEL, CG Power) benefiting from multi-year government order backlogs and capacity expansions. Avoid loose, extended setups in high-beta financials until post-policy liquidity finds equilibrium.

Expanding domestic propulsion and sonar systems programs

news.headline: RBI MPC raises repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%, shifts stance to 'calibrated tightening'
news.summary: In an unscheduled tightening pivot on October 7, 2026, the RBI MPC raised the policy repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% and shifted its stance from neutral to calibrated tightening. Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that rate cuts are completely off the table in the near term amid West Asia oil shocks and revised the FY27 inflation projection up to 5.2% while projecting 7.1% GDP growth.
news.impact: Triggers immediate multiple compression in rate-sensitive sectors; swing setups should require tighter stops and favor non-levered momentum.

news.headline: HAL commissions ₹218 crore 2nd Shakti Engine line at Koraput division; delivers 2,000th aero-engine
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited operationalized its second dedicated Shakti engine manufacturing facility at Sunabeda, Koraput, established at a capex of ₹218 crore to deliver up to 100 engines annually. The inauguration, attended by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, commemorates HAL's 2,000th delivered engine and directly de-bottlenecks engine supply for indigenous Dhruv ALH and Prachand combat helicopters.
news.impact: Reinforces production capacity visibility, providing structural support for swing continuation off the ₹4,750 base towards the ₹5,000 psychological handle.

news.headline: Trent surges 13% after Q2 revenue climbs 23% YoY to ₹5,788 cr; Zudio crosses 1,000 stores
news.summary: Tata Group retailer Trent registered a high-volume breakout, rising nearly 13% after reporting a 23% YoY jump in Q2 standalone revenue to ₹5,788 crore, with total H1FY27 revenue reaching ₹11,454 crore. The company reached a footprint milestone with 1,342 total lifestyle stores as Zudio crossed the 1,000-store mark, prompting bullish coverage initiations across global desks including BofA and Morgan Stanley.
news.impact: Decisive stage-one volume breakout above key 20-day and 200-day moving averages (₹2,740-₹2,775), establishing the benchmark high-momentum retail leader.

news.headline: Motilal Oswal names BEL top defence pick on ₹13 lakh crore government approval pipeline
news.summary: Motilal Oswal Securities reiterated Bharat Electronics as its top pick across the defence sector, highlighting that DAC approvals reached ₹1.62 lakh crore in FY27 YTD, contributing to an overall ₹13 lakh crore approval backlog over FY25-FY27. Ordering momentum is expected to accelerate into H2FY27 as major contracts including QRSAM, Akash-NG, and naval sensor suites approach final commercial clearances.
news.impact: Serves as an institutional catalyst defending the stock's ₹380 swing floor, favoring an accumulation range breakout setup on order finalization news.

news.headline: Nomura pegs CG Power as key winner of ₹1.9 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III scheme
news.summary: Nomura initiated positive coverage on CG Power and Industrial Solutions following Union Cabinet approval of the ₹1.86-1.90 lakh crore GEC-III (PM Dhara) program. The scheme requires evacuation infrastructure for 135 GW RE and 50 GWh battery storage, directly expanding addressable order volume for CG Power alongside its newly commissioned 45,000 MVA Sehore transformer facility and OSAT semiconductor expansion.
news.impact: Strengthens ascending base continuation pattern above ₹885, positioning the counter to challenge resistance at ₹915-₹925 on multi-week horizon.

news.headline: Axis Bank gross advances surge 22.7% YoY in Q2 update; mobilises $10.6B in FCNR(B) deposits
news.summary: Axis Bank reported provisional business figures for Q2 ended September 30, with gross advances jumping 22.7% YoY and 8.8% QoQ to ₹13.85 lakh crore, while total deposits expanded 20.7% YoY to ₹14.52 lakh crore. The expansion was assisted by $10.62 billion (₹1.02 lakh crore) mobilized under the RBI's FCNR(B) swap window, though term deposits outpaced CASA growth.
news.impact: Provides short-term bounce momentum to test ₹1,250 resistance, though upside breakout velocity remains capped by repo rate hike headwinds on NIMs.

news.headline: SEBI evaluates partial rollback of Closing Auction Session derivative settlement framework
news.summary: Capital market infrastructure counters rallied after reports confirmed SEBI is evaluating market feedback to refine or partly walk back recent Closing Auction Session (CAS) expiry-day settlement rules following volume friction and broker representation. BSE, Groww, and related market plays logged 3-4% gains as trading volume expectations normalized.
news.impact: Removes an overhang of severe derivative volume compression, sparking quick mean-reversion swings in capital market platform proxies.

news.headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank advances rise 24.7% YoY in Q2 provisional update; deposits up 23%
news.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported strong provisional operational metrics for Q2 FY27, with net advances advancing 24.7% YoY to ₹5.77 lakh crore and total deposits expanding 23% YoY. The stock gained over 3.5% on heavy volume following the filing, reflecting robust credit appetite ahead of audited earnings.
news.impact: Tests local swing swing-high resistance at ₹435; price action requires confirmation of follow-through volume given broader rate tightening context.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard consolidates near ₹1,280 base following ship repair JV and OFS absorption
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard trades within a consolidating base near ₹1,280-₹1,300 after absorbing the government's 5% OFS and a subdued Q1 net profit (down 19% YoY to ₹151.5 crore). Swing focus rests on execution of the newly formed joint venture with DP World arm Drydocks World to operate the International Ship Repair Facility (ISRF) in Kochi alongside Indian Navy next-generation missile vessel keels.
news.impact: Constructing a post-correction lateral base; wait for decisive volume surge above the ₹1,320 pivot before anticipating multi-week trend reversal.

news.headline: CG Power intimation confirms senior management change in transformer unit ahead of Q2 results
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions notified the stock exchanges that Ajay Jain, Vice President of the Transformer Business, resigned effective September 30, 2026, due to personal commitments. The disclosure comes as the company closed its trading window on September 30 ahead of its scheduled Q2 earnings release, with trading volume holding steady at 1.2x 20-day average.
news.impact: Routine executive turnover intimation with minimal disruption to ongoing production lines; watch upcoming Q2 board meeting date announcement as the true catalyst.
